wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Vegetation Near Structure; Open Green Space; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Scattered Shrubs; Large Trees; Multiple Access Routes; Open Terrain; Grass Cover
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to the structure to create more open space between individual trees.
• Trim lower branches on large trees close to the structure to raise the canopy off the ground.
• Cut back shrubs that are directly touching or within a few feet of the structure's walls or foundation.
• Mow or cut grass cover close to the structure, particularly where it grows up against the building.
• Keep grass in open areas around the structure cut short during dry periods.
• Remove dead or dry grass accumulation from beneath scattered shrubs near the structure.
• Trim overhanging branches from large trees above the roofline or gutters.
• Keep both access routes clear of low-hanging branches and encroaching vegetation along the edges.
• Maintain open ground between the scattered trees and any outbuildings or fencing connected to the main structure.
• Remove any dead branches or debris that has accumulated under the tree cluster closest to the structure.
